seo.title: Pre-Purchase Property Survey Dublin | MF Project Solutions
seo.description: Pre-purchase property inspection of second-hand homes in Dublin, Meath and Kildare for €650 plus VAT. A practical written report before you sign.

hero.h1: Pre-purchase property inspection in Dublin and Meath
hero.sub: A practical inspection of a second-hand home by construction people, before you sign. You get a written report on what we found and what needs a closer look.
bullets: For second-hand homes, before you sign

proof.title: Construction people
proof.text: The inspection is carried out by people who build and renovate homes, so the report focuses on what matters in practice.

proof.title: Honest about limits
proof.text: Where something needs an engineer or another specialist, the report says so instead of guessing.

proof.title: Costs if you want them
proof.text: On request, we add an estimate for the repairs and upgrades you are considering.

intro.title: Know what you are buying
paragraphs: A second-hand home can hide damp, tired windows or a roof that needs work. Our pre-purchase property inspection looks at the visible condition of the house and tells you, in plain English, what we found.
Wanessa leads our property inspection service and is your contact from booking to report.

gallery.title: Inspections and reports
gallery.intro: Photos from our inspections and sample report pages are being added.

included.title: What the inspection covers
items: Visible condition of the roof, from the ground and accessible areas
A visual check of the services
The attic, if it is accessible
A clear written report, with anything that needs a specialist flagged

price.headline: €650 plus VAT
price.note: For a pre-purchase property inspection of a second-hand home. An optional repair and upgrade estimate is available on request.

process.title: Book
process.text: Send us the address and where you are in the sale by WhatsApp, phone or the form.

process.title: Inspection
process.text: We inspect the visible condition of the house, including the attic if it is accessible.

process.title: Written report
process.text: You receive a clear report of what we found, with anything that needs an engineer or specialist flagged.

process.title: Estimate, if you want one
process.text: On request, we price the repairs and upgrades you are considering.

faqs.q: Does the inspection include structural calculations?
faqs.a: No. It is a practical pre-purchase property inspection of the visible condition of the home. We do not carry out structural calculations. Where something needs an engineer, the report says so.
Before you sign. The report is most useful while you can still ask questions or negotiate.

faqs.q: Do you test the heating and electrics?
faqs.a: Services are checked visually. We do not test services unless that has been agreed in advance.

faqs.q: Can you tell me what repairs will cost?
faqs.a: Yes. On request, we add an estimate for repairs and upgrades to the report.
Wanessa leads the property inspection service and is your contact from booking to report.

crossSell.label: Snag list inspections
crossSell.text: Buying a new build? Book a snag inspection with a photo report for the builder.

cta.title: Buying a second-hand home?
cta.text: Send us the address and your timeline. We will confirm a date for the inspection and the written report.

sections.title: What we inspect
bullets: Roof: visible condition from the ground and accessible areas

sections.title: What we do not do
paragraphs: Where something needs an engineer, the report says so.
bullets: No opening up of floors, walls or finishes
No testing of services unless agreed in advance
